name: Hyperdrive HL Lending
rootCause: The DeFi protocol Hyperdrive, built on the Hyperliquid chain, was exploited. The attacker repeatedly abused an arbitrary call vulnerability in the router, resulting in a loss of approximately $782,000.

descriptions.text: The DeFi protocol Hyperdrive, built on the Hyperliquid chain, was exploited. The attacker repeatedly abused an arbitrary call vulnerability in the router, resulting in a loss of approximately $782,000.

On 27 September 2025, Hyperdrive HL Lending on Hyperliquid L1 was exploited through a router contract vulnerability allowing arbitrary function calls, enabling the systematic drainage of about $782,000 in USDT0 and thBILL tokens. The attacker bridged the assets to BNB Chain and Ethereum before the protocol paused markets and issued a patch. No primary on-chain or contract evidence is published, and compensation details remain incomplete. The exploit was caused by a vulnerability in the Hyperdrive router contract that allowed arbitrary external calls without proper access controls, permitting attackers to withdraw assets from two lending markets irrespective of intended authorization checks.
